text:
laura: Quick ask — can we lock a 45m design review next week for the Unified Auth flow (API + SDK + Console UX)? Pre-read: https://redwood.app/drive/unified-auth-pre-read (short mockups + API spec). Need PM sign-off + at least one SDK engineer + UX. Preferred window Tue/Wed afternoon.
ben: I'm +1. Tue 2–3pm or Wed 3–4pm works for me.
tejas: Wed 3pm works better. Can we make it 30m if we focus on decision points?
laura: i'd prefer 45 to cover integration questions but ok to aim for 35 if needed. agenda draft below:
```
1) 5m goal/context
2) 15m API contract & security
3) 10m SDK ergonomics
4) 10m Console UX screens + rollout plan
5) 5m action items
```

laura: Pre-read checklist (copy paste):
- Read API spec (sec sections)
- Try quick auth flow in sandbox (link: https://redwood.app/sandbox/auth)
- Note any blocking questions in the doc
- Bring one rollout risk/mitigation

morgan: FYI: can we include canary rollback criteria? that's critical for ops.
chris: I'll bring telemetry & latency numbers for current auth calls. Also nominate reviewers: @tejas @sara for SDK, @morgan for infra.
sara: I'm ok to review SDK bits — Wed 3pm is fine.
ben: Wed 3–3:45 then? I can hold that.
tejas: wed 3:00-3:30 preferred, but i'll stay 45 if needed. :thumbsup:
laura: consensus = Wed 15:00 PST, 45m. I'll send calendar invite and attach pre-read. Please add any blocking items in the doc by Tue EOD.
calendar-bot: Calendar invite created — 'Design Review: Unified Auth (API/SDK/Console)' Wed, 15:00-15:45 PST. RSVP +1: laura, ben, tejas, morgan, sara, chris
ben: added to calendar. thanks.
sara: quick note — for SDK section, can we allocate 8–10m to discuss error model v2? I can prep a 2-slide summary.
laura: yes — add to agenda item 3, we'll steal 2m from UX.
morgan: ack. I'll outline rollback criteria in the doc by Tue morning.
laura: thanks all — will ping again if schedule changes. :calendar:
